NUFFT imaging

Accelerate Bench task · Numerics, tensors & graphs

NUFFT imaging reconstructs an image from nonuniform Fourier measurements.

Task version1.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The application bins the observations and solves a regularized inverse imaging problem with conjugate gradients.

Correctness

The verifier checks the permutation, bin offsets, reconstructed image, residual and iteration history against reference computations.

Timing

Timing covers the complete reconstruction process.
